mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) relative to historical averages indicates strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy expands.
failure_condition: HOUST > 800 and 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 0.05% signals an aggressive monetary policy stance, which suppresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 0.05 and 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market characterized by high employment (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) signals robust economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS > 130000 and UNRATE < 5.0% and 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230), the S&P 500 is expected to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to the heightened risk of aggressive monetary tightening.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 230 and 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 10-year average indicates robust economic activity, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately a quarter).
failure_condition: INDPRO > 100 and 60-day returns are negative in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A joint high level of housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong economic demand and supply conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST > 800 and INDPRO > 100 and 20-day returns are negative in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE > 6.0) indicates a weak labor market, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 6.0 and 20-day returns are positive in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) relative to its 5-year average indicates strong consumer spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 400000 and 5-day returns are negative in > 50% of such periods over a 3-year rolling window.
